posts_answers: Holds post records for answers (one row per post) with keys id, parent_id (question id), post_type_id; measures/attributes include title, body, accepted_answer_id, answer_count, comment_count, community_owned_date, creation_date, favorite_count, last_activity_date, last_edit_date, last_editor_display_name, last_editor_user_id, owner_display_name, owner_user_id, score, tags, view_count.
users: Holds user profiles (one row per user) keyed by id with attributes display_name, about_me, age, creation_date, last_access_date, location, reputation, up_votes, down_votes, views, profile_image_url, website_url.
posts_orphaned_tag_wiki: Holds post-like records for orphaned tag wiki entries (one row per post/wiki) keyed by id (and parent_id when present) with attributes title, body, accepted_answer_id, answer_count, comment_count, community_owned_date, creation_date, favorite_count, last_activity_date, last_edit_date, last_editor_display_name, last_editor_user_id, owner_display_name, owner_user_id, post_type_id, score, tags, view_count.
posts_tag_wiki: Holds post-like records for tag wiki entries (one row per post/wiki) keyed by id (and parent_id when present) with attributes title, body, accepted_answer_id, answer_count, comment_count, community_owned_date, creation_date, favorite_count, last_activity_date, last_edit_date, last_editor_display_name, last_editor_user_id, owner_display_name, owner_user_id, post_type_id, score, tags, view_count.
stackoverflow_posts: Holds Stack Overflow post records (one row per post) keyed by id with parent_id for answers, post_type_id; includes title, body, accepted_answer_id, answer_count, comment_count, community_owned_date, creation_date, favorite_count, last_activity_date, last_edit_date, last_editor_display_name, last_editor_user_id, owner_display_name, owner_user_id, score, tags, view_count.
posts_questions: Holds post records for questions (one row per question) keyed by id with attributes title, body, accepted_answer_id, answer_count, comment_count, community_owned_date, creation_date, favorite_count, last_activity_date, last_edit_date, last_editor_display_name, last_editor_user_id, owner_display_name, owner_user_id, post_type_id, score, tags, view_count.
comments: Holds comment records (one row per comment) keyed by id with foreign key post_id and user_id; attributes include text, creation_date, user_display_name, score.
posts_tag_wiki_excerpt: Holds post-like records for tag wiki excerpts (one row per excerpt) keyed by id with attributes title, body, accepted_answer_id, answer_count, comment_count, community_owned_date, creation_date, favorite_count, last_activity_date, last_edit_date, last_editor_display_name, last_editor_user_id, owner_display_name, owner_user_id, parent_id, post_type_id, score, tags, view_count.
posts_wiki_placeholder: Holds placeholder post/wiki records (one row per placeholder) keyed by id with attributes title, body, accepted_answer_id, answer_count, comment_count, community_owned_date, creation_date, favorite_count, last_activity_date, last_edit_date, last_editor_display_name, last_editor_user_id, owner_display_name, owner_user_id, parent_id, post_type_id, score, tags, view_count.
posts_privilege_wiki: Holds post-like records for privilege wiki entries (one row per entry) keyed by id with attributes title, body, accepted_answer_id, answer_count, comment_count, community_owned_date, creation_date, favorite_count, last_activity_date, last_edit_date, last_editor_display_name, last_editor_user_id, owner_display_name, owner_user_id, parent_id, post_type_id, score, tags, view_count.
post_history: Holds post revision history (one row per history entry) keyed by id with foreign key post_id and user_id; attributes include creation_date, post_history_type_id, revision_guid, text, comment.
badges: Holds badge awards (one row per awarded badge) keyed by id with attributes name, date, user_id, class, tag_based.
post_links: Holds relationships between posts; grain = one link record per relationship with keys/fields id, creation_date, link_type_id, post_id, related_post_id.
tags: Holds tag metadata; grain = one tag per row with keys/fields id, tag_name, count, excerpt_post_id, wiki_post_id.
votes: Holds votes on posts; grain = one vote per row with keys/fields id, creation_date, post_id, vote_type_id.
posts_moderator_nomination: Holds moderator nomination post records; grain = one post per row with fields id, title, body, accepted_answer_id, answer_count, comment_count, community_owned_date, creation_date, favorite_count, last_activity_date, last_edit_date, last_editor_display_name, last_editor_user_id, owner_display_name, owner_user_id, parent_id, post_type_id, score, tags, view_count.
